philosophy: You are sourcing for a high-bar frontier AI role. The person you save will partner with researchers at OpenAI, Anthropic, and DeepMind to build RL environments, post-training pipelines, and evaluation infrastructure. Ask: 'Would this person be credible in that room?'

pedigree.description: MSc/PhD from strong research institution + 5+ years applied ML + evidence of building products or leading teams. May lack explicit RL keywords but trajectory says they can do the job.
pedigree.example: PhD Physics top-tier > 5yr postdoc > 5yr applied ML building production systems > led team of 7

direct_experience.description: Clear signal of hands-on work in RLHF pipelines, RL environment design, reward/verifier systems, LLM fine-tuning, coding agent infrastructure, eval/benchmark systems. 4-5 years enough IF directly relevant.
counts: Multi-agent systems with real ML backbone
does_not_count: RLHF in headline but works at annotation company
